pages.text: Use this redstone-powered block to observe a qBlock automatically.
Place it directly beside the qBlock. The redstone input goes on the side opposite the qBlock. To build the next experiment, stand to the east and place it facing you.
pages.title: Set the Orientation

pages.text: Power the observer to start an observation. Switch it off and wait for the qBlock to return to inert. Step away or wear $(l:qcraft:qblocks/goggles)Anti-Observation Goggles$(/l) while testing.
pages.title: Reset the Target
